name: Avatar
description: `Avatar` renders a user or organization image at a consistent size and shape. Use `square` for organizations and other non-person entities.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner treatment. `circle` suits a person, `square` suits an organization or other entity.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered width and height in pixels. Accepts a responsive object to vary the size per viewport.

props.name: square
props.description: Forces the square shape, taking precedence over `shape`. Kept for compatibility with `@primer/react`.
